plugins.name: bargainproxy-opencode
plugins.description: Sync ZCode's personal providers with the OpenCode free models served by a local BargainProxy gateway (chat / responses / anthropic).

description_i18n.zh-CN: 从本机 BargainProxy 网关同步 OpenCode 免费模型：维护三个个人供应商（Chat / Response / Anthropic 三条协议线），ZCode 启动时自动刷新；只动自己的三个供应商，写前备份、写后校验、失败回滚。
